bio.text: Teresa Leger Fernández represents New Mexico's 3rd Congressional District and serves on the House Rules Committee and the Natural Resources Committee.
Her office says she was born in Las Vegas, New Mexico, and is a 17th-generation New Mexican.
She graduated from Yale and Stanford Law School and worked as a public interest attorney, a White House Fellow, and Vice Chair of the Advisory Council on Historic Preservation.
